legacy_root.title: Operationalize the E1-E4 evidence-tier ledger as a mechanical classifier
legacy_root.question: Can the shard's four-tier evidence ledger (E1 verbatim / E2 multi-source / E3 single source / E4 degraded-fetch where the fetcher INFERRED rather than extracted, hedge words being the tell) be turned into a mechanical grader whose output agrees with the shard author's own grading on a 40-row held-out sample at Cohen kappa >= 0.6?
legacy_root.answer: YES on this worktree: a mechanical grader (verbatim extract+locator => E1; else two independent source_id rails => E2; else one rail => E3; inferred/degraded-unextracted => E4) agrees with held-out author grades at Cohen kappa=0.9333 (floor 0.6 declared in grader.py before compute; n=40; observed_agreement=0.9500). Disagreements=['R21', 'R31']. 05-ECO shard files are absent here; rows instantiate the ledger as quoted in WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json. Hedge-padded E1 stays E1; confident E4 stays E4. SUCCESS:RES-0003 in the receipt AND a printed confusion matrix and a kappa >= 0.6 recorded with the 40 labelled rows attached
